test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the given letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

#: GLO:: INQ: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : GLO :: INQ : %

Analysis of Options:

**Option 1) # = BGJ, % = NSV**

**For # (BGJ) to GLO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83d5a120719c108617dd86ef98aab383854b42d436cb9ca32aa8549788a7f116.png] 

 

**For INQ to % (NSV)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/defdf7fc2ea3d490c0bc23458933a060b4e0a034415b04bd37ee59ab99664dce.png] 

 

Option 1 is correct.

**Option 2) # = BPU, % = MTG**

**For # (BPU) to GLO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68638fe95f632ccdc5b47ed607806740fc34ce794add05d02c589ab77a45d029.png] 

 

**For INQ to % (MTG)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca6d820586ed8b54f1994d16472bbaccb6861c51b9987edda8318cf013884ede.png] 

 

**Option 3) # = DFR, % = NPY**

**For # (DFR) to GLO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5ee57455b673ad6b1e0d1eeae1a0957b4496cbac9235e23db3c30ca9bfd82cb.png] 

 

**For INQ to % (NPY)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/255d6dd313b37a5793528af8733dc8e712d8e182badfe6a51c4feb90729d5773.png] 

 

**Option 4) # = EDG, % = MGV**

**For # (EDG) to GLO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aac4fb90906e0fb63278b02f953381c0e3ae78ae8d3365d1a05e458631d646f3.png] 

 

**For INQ to % (MGV)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5d8ca2e92f38159270398cfc24368ff05a04788d976c396d5b8b11174c84bf1.png] 

 

Thus, the analogy holds true only for Option 1 where the pattern (+5, +5, +5) is consistent for both pairs.

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
